invariants.rationale: Since the method always throws an exception and never returns normally, the result is conceptually never assigned and can be considered null at any normal 'exit'.
Because the method always throws an exception and never reaches a return statement, no valid result can exist, making any nontrivial property about result vacuously true.
A required precondition for method invocation in Java; context is a non-null parameter.
A required precondition for correct method invocation; instantTime should be non-null.
Method parameter Option<Map<String, String>> extraMetadata should be non-null (even if Option can be empty).
